context: A couple chooses a restaurant for a special date
purpose: Teach: 鶏/調理/放題/代金/飲食/定員/ピーク/支払う

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえ、記念日なんだから、ちょっと素敵な飲食店を予約したいな。
lines.en: Hey, since it's our anniversary, I'd like to book a nice restaurant.
lines.style: Soft, affectionate tone, leaning gently toward her partner.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いいね。鶏料理が美味しい店を見つけたんだけど、どう思う?
lines.en: Sounds good. I found a place with great chicken dishes, what do you think?
lines.style: Cheerful and eager, university-student warmth, slightly excited.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 鶏ばっかりはちょっと…記念日に食べ放題ってロマンチックじゃないでしょ。
lines.en: All chicken is a bit much... an all-you-can-eat isn't very romantic for an anniversary.
lines.style: Playfully teasing, half-laughing, gentle protest with warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 確かに。じゃあ、目の前で調理してくれる鉄板焼きのお店はどう?
lines.en: True. Then how about a teppanyaki place where they cook right in front of you?
lines.style: Backpedaling sweetly, brightening with a new idea, enthusiastic.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: それいい!でもピークの時間は混むから、早めに予約しないと定員いっぱいで入れないかも。
lines.en: That's great! But peak hours get crowded, so if we don't book early it might be full.
lines.style: Excited then practical, lightly cautioning, hands-on planning tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 了解、今すぐ電話するよ。代金は俺が支払うから、メイは楽しみにしてて。
lines.en: Got it, I'll call right now. I'll pay the bill, so Mei, just look forward to it.
lines.style: Confident and tender, taking charge proudly, boyfriend-mode warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: もう、優しい〜。じゃあ次のデートは私がおごるからね。
lines.en: Aww, so sweet~. Then I'll treat you on our next date, okay?
lines.style: Melting affectionate giggle, playful promise, soft romantic energy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 約束ね。当日は綺麗な服着てきてよ、楽しみにしてる。
lines.en: It's a promise. Wear something pretty that day, I'm looking forward to it.
lines.style: Quietly happy, a little shy, sincere boyish smile in voice.
